model-input.label: Input tokens
model-input.description: Native token IDs. A valid token mask and document boundaries control attention and state resets.

model-embedding.label: Embedding
model-embedding.description: Input embeddings share their weight matrix with the output vocabulary projection.

model-block-1.label: MLA + dense FFN
model-block-1.description: Each block has independent parameters. Each sequence mixing and FFN sublayer is pre-normalized and residual.

model-block-2.label: MLA + MoE
model-block-2.description: Each block has independent parameters. Each sequence mixing and FFN sublayer is pre-normalized and residual.

model-block-3.label: MLA + dense FFN
model-block-3.description: Each block has independent parameters. Each sequence mixing and FFN sublayer is pre-normalized and residual.

model-block-4.label: MLA/GDN + MoE
model-block-4.description: Each block has independent parameters. Each sequence mixing and FFN sublayer is pre-normalized and residual.

model-final-norm.label: RMSNorm
model-final-norm.description: Final RMS normalization before the vocabulary projection.

model-head.label: Linear / tied head
model-head.description: Bias-free output projection; no additional embedding matrix is counted.

model-logits.label: Output logits
model-logits.description: Next-token logits. Native inference uses a compressed attention cache and GDN recurrent/convolution states.

model-hidden-in.label: Hidden state x
model-hidden-in.description: Input to one hybrid decoder layer. Dashed paths preserve residuals around mixing and FFN.

model-attention-norm.label: RMSNorm
model-attention-norm.description: The same normalized hidden state is fed to MLA, GDN and the scalar fusion router.

model-mla.label: Latent attention
model-mla.description: Low-rank query and KV projections, decoupled RoPE, causal SDPA and a compressed KV cache.

model-fusion-router.label: Fusion gate g
model-fusion-router.description: A separate per-token scalar router blends attention and recurrence. Both branches execute.

model-gdn.label: Gated DeltaNet
model-gdn.description: Q/K/V causal depthwise convolutions, FP32 delta recurrence and output gating.

model-blend.label: Weighted blend
model-blend.description: Soft fusion combines both full branch outputs. It does not skip one branch.

model-attn-add.label: Add residual
model-attn-add.description: First residual connection around the sequence mixing sublayer.

model-ffn-norm.label: RMSNorm
model-ffn-norm.description: A distinct pre-FFN normalization feeds the shared expert and the routed expert branch.

model-moe.label: Shared + routed MoE
model-moe.description: An always-active shared SwiGLU plus the weighted sum of two selected SwiGLU experts. Expert routing is independent of the attention fusion gate.

model-ffn-add.label: Add residual
model-ffn-add.description: Second residual connection. Padding positions are zeroed after the block.

model-hidden-out.label: Hidden state
model-hidden-out.description: Same hidden width, with document-aware attention and recurrent resets preserved.

mla-input.label: Normalized input u
mla-input.description: Output of the decoder attention RMSNorm. Three branches construct queries, latent keys/values and rotary keys.

mla-q-up.label: Q up-projection
mla-q-up.description: Expand latent queries into per-head content and rotary components.

mla-q-rope.label: Split Q / apply RoPE
mla-q-rope.description: RoPE acts only on the rotary query coordinates. Content queries are unchanged.

mla-kv-down.label: KV down-projection
mla-kv-down.description: Shared compressed latent for content keys and values.

mla-kv-norm.label: RMSNorm
mla-kv-norm.description: The normalized latent is retained in the inference cache.

mla-kv-cache.label: Latent KV cache
mla-kv-cache.description: Cache stores compressed KV latent plus the 16-dimensional rotary key, not expanded per-head keys/values.

mla-kv-expand.label: K/V up-projections
mla-kv-expand.description: Reconstruct expanded content keys and values from the latent for this attention call.

mla-k-rope.label: Rotary-key projection
mla-k-rope.description: A shared rotary key is projected directly from the input.

mla-key-rope.label: RoPE + rotary cache
mla-key-rope.description: Apply position rotation and retain rotary keys across decoding calls.

mla-key-join.label: Concatenate K
mla-key-join.description: Broadcast the rotary key across heads and concatenate with per-head content keys.

mla-sdpa.label: Causal attention / SDPA
mla-sdpa.description: Scaled dot-product attention honors causal, document and padding masks. FlashAttention is an optional separately validated backend.

mla-out-proj.label: Output projection
mla-out-proj.description: Concatenate all value heads and project back to hidden width. The baseline optional MLA head gate is disabled.

moe-input.label: Normalized input v
moe-input.description: Only valid tokens participate in dispatch and router statistics.

moe-shared.label: Always-active shared expert
moe-shared.description: The shared expert runs for every valid token. Its output is added without a routed-expert weight.

moe-router.label: Expert router / Linear
moe-router.description: A distinct bias-free linear router produces one logit per expert. These are not the hybrid attention fusion weights.

moe-topk.label: Top-2 + selected softmax
moe-topk.description: Select the two highest logits and normalize only those selected logits with softmax.

moe-expert-0.label: E0
moe-expert-0.description: One routed SwiGLU expert. Two experts are selected dynamically for each token; no fixed expert pair is implied.

moe-expert-1.label: E1
moe-expert-1.description: One routed SwiGLU expert. Two experts are selected dynamically for each token; no fixed expert pair is implied.

moe-expert-2.label: E2
moe-expert-2.description: One routed SwiGLU expert. Two experts are selected dynamically for each token; no fixed expert pair is implied.

moe-expert-3.label: E3
moe-expert-3.description: One routed SwiGLU expert. Two experts are selected dynamically for each token; no fixed expert pair is implied.

moe-expert-4.label: E4
moe-expert-4.description: One routed SwiGLU expert. Two experts are selected dynamically for each token; no fixed expert pair is implied.

moe-expert-5.label: E5
moe-expert-5.description: One routed SwiGLU expert. Two experts are selected dynamically for each token; no fixed expert pair is implied.

moe-expert-6.label: E6
moe-expert-6.description: One routed SwiGLU expert. Two experts are selected dynamically for each token; no fixed expert pair is implied.

moe-expert-7.label: E7
moe-expert-7.description: One routed SwiGLU expert. Two experts are selected dynamically for each token; no fixed expert pair is implied.

moe-weighted.label: Weighted sum of selected outputs
moe-weighted.description: The selected expert outputs are scaled by their router weights and accumulated back into the original token positions.

moe-sum.label: Add shared + routed
moe-sum.description: Final MoE output equals the always-active shared output plus the selected weighted expert outputs.
